extract_figures_from_pdf: extract figures from a PDF file using pdffigures2 and save them to a specified directory
call_pdffigures_with_timeout: call pdffigures2 on a PDF with a custom timeout and verbose output enabled
review_call_pdffigures: review the call_pdffigures function that extracts figures from PDFs using pdffigures2 via a Java subprocess
summarize_pdffigures_module: summarize the pdffigures module which wraps pdffigures2 to extract figures and metadata from PDF files
test_call_pdffigures: test the call_pdffigures function by running it against a sample PDF and verifying the JSON output file
